title: Heartland — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Heartland.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Heritage Cooking." Specialty tier. Heartland (by Elmira Stove Works, now Middleby) makes antique-styled ranges that bring Victorian and early-American charm to modern kitchens. Gas burners, electric ovens, and hand-finished details in multiple colors.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Heritage and country kitchen builds. Customers who want character over commercial styling.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Heartland:

• Antique styling that no other brand offers

• Hand-finished details and craftsmanship

• Multiple color options for heritage kitchens

• Modern cooking technology in vintage form

• Unique offering for character-driven kitchen designs
